decision: Port the value_label_mode and stop_slot_accounting config knobs from the never-merged SLM-308 (ae5448c5) / SLM-310 (d8f35563) forks onto main, default-off, rather than re-expressing the SLM-317 historical/improved arms against main without them.
non_goals_honored: No change to the do-no-harm commit rule, the frozen SLM-155 corpus, or any ship/production claim.
No weakening of the preregistered min_pass_rate=0.5 threshold to force a decision.
No change to the frozen SLM-279 depth-supervision arithmetic contract (unrelated model).
LAR3 is NOT declared reopened or closed by this issue beyond what the powered rerun result itself states; SLM-432 (LAR4-06) remains correctly gated since LAR3 authorization was not achieved.

powered_rerun_result.summary: Safety PASS (invalid_over_valid=0), reachability PASS, value gate FAIL: Wilson 95% CI [0.0, 0.161] over 20 seeds vs required min_pass_rate 0.5. Both ar_only and every repair arm sit at 100% hard-valid rate on the frozen SLM-155 fixture corpus (no invalid AR baseline exists for repair to fix), so no seed can show a paired improvement. LAR3 stays CLOSED: this is the second of the two PR #853-#856 reopening conditions and it is not met.

regression_evidence: Full pre-existing tests/test_models/test_tree_edit_diffusion.py (10), tests/test_harnesses/experiments/test_slm299_edit_reachability.py, and tests/test_harnesses/experiments/test_slm317_repair_hybrid.py suites pass unmodified after the port, proving default (mutation_count + legacy) behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged. 8 new tests added to test_tree_edit_diffusion.py + 7 new tests in test_slm308_distance_oracle.py cover the new bounded_distance / corrected arms, validation errors, the accept-only reason shim, and a no-oracle-at-decode audit.

SLM-310 corruption_action_distribution reweighting knob (SLM-317 harness never references it)

why_port_not_reexpress: Re-expressing (route b) would have been a no-op for the historical arm only -- main.training_loss/_decode_one already implement exactly mutation_count value labels (1 - applied/(max_chain+1)) and legacy STOP-slot accounting (every STOP proposal consumes a slot), confirmed by the full pre-existing test suite passing unmodified after the port. But the improved arm inherently needs the bounded_distance oracle + corrected STOP accounting -- there is no way to re-express that arm without the knobs; per the SLM-434 contract ("if (b) changes what the arms measure, prefer (a)"), route (a) was mandatory for that arm, so the port covers both.
